entries.what_happened: The family has one manuscript, 'Canonical ampleness of compact hyperbolic Kähler manifolds' (build/main.tex, dated 23 September 2026, author listed as OpenAI). Its Theorem 1.1 says: if X is a compact connected Kähler manifold of complex dimension n ≥ 1 and every holomorphic map ℂ → X is constant, then Kₓ is ample, so a positive power of Kₓ embeds X in projective space. The abstract calls this a positive resolution of Kobayashi's canonical-ampleness conjecture in the smooth compact Kähler setting. The argument runs as follows. A maximizing-disc argument gives a uniform bound on the Poisson Ricci integral for all finite-area discs, which gives nefness of Kₓ through bounded plurisubharmonic canonical weights and a smoothing lemma (sections 'Extremal discs', 'Bounded canonical potentials and nefness', and the appendix on smoothing). A second use of the same disc identities gives a uniform lower bound on hⁿ/kⁿ for any Kähler metric h with Ricci curvature at least −h. With Aubin–Yau metrics in the classes 2πc₁(Kₓ) + t[k], this gives ∫c₁(Kₓ)ⁿ > 0. Nefness plus positive top self-intersection then give bigness and Moishezon-ness, Moishezon plus Kähler gives projectivity, and the absence of rational curves, via a Kodaira-lemma decomposition and the log cone theorem, upgrades bigness to ampleness. The same manuscript also states two corollaries that the main proof does not use. Corollary 1: for a compact connected Brody-hyperbolic Kähler manifold of dimension n ≥ 1, Kₓ^{⊗m} is globally generated for every m ≥ n+2. Corollary 2: under an extra semialgebraic hypothesis on the universal cover, X has a finite étale cover of the form (D/Γ₀) × F. The manuscript never mentions the abundance conjecture.
entries.delivers: For smooth compact connected Kähler manifolds of positive dimension with no nonconstant entire curves (these are projective by the same theorem; no singularities and no boundary divisor), the canonical bundle Kₓ is ample. Ampleness gives some positive multiple of Kₓ that is base-point free, so the conclusion of the bullet, semiampleness, holds in this class, with the hypothesis that Kₓ is nef derived from hyperbolicity rather than assumed. Corollary 1 additionally gives explicit base-point-freeness of Kₓ^{⊗m} for m ≥ n+2 in the same class, conditional as noted below. The statement is over ℂ. The bullet's general form (klt projective varieties with nef canonical bundle, possibly with boundary) is not what the manuscript states. The manuscript does not claim to settle the abundance conjecture; the overlap is the ampleness conclusion for one special class.
entries.remains: Still open, if the claim is correct, is the general bullet: (i) projective varieties with singular klt singularities; (ii) klt pairs with a boundary Δ and nef K + Δ; (iii) nef canonical bundles that are not ample (numerically trivial, nef and big but not ample, or Iitaka dimension strictly between 0 and n), since hyperbolicity excludes these cases; (iv) varieties over fields other than ℂ, including positive characteristic. Within the smooth Brody-hyperbolic class, no semiampleness question is left open if the claim is correct.
entries.direction: proves a special case: Kₓ is ample, hence semiample, for smooth compact Kähler Brody-hyperbolic manifolds; this is Kobayashi's canonical-ampleness conjecture in that class
entries.conditional_on: No hypothesis beyond the stated one (absence of nonconstant entire curves). The proof uses cited results without proving them: the Aubin–Yau negative-sign Monge–Ampère theorem; Demailly's holomorphic Morse inequalities; Poletsky–Rosay disc envelopes in the Drinovec Drnovšek–Forstnerič form; Kollár's log resolution theorem; Fujino's log cone theorem and Kleiman's criterion; Moishezon's projectivity theorem; and the standard Oka–Grauert, Wiener–Masani and Helson–Lowdenslager results. For the final ampleness step the text cites Diverio–Trapani Lemma 2.1 and Diverio Lemma 5.1, then gives its own argument. Corollary 1 is not used in the main theorem, but its proof depends on OpenAIFujita2026 Corollary 6.3 (Fujita freeness in all-powers form, exponent n+1). Corollary 2 depends on OpenAISemialgebraicCovers2026 Theorem 1.1. Neither of those two manuscripts was read here.
entries.doubts: The text flags no step as sketched and contains no explicit hedge. Points to weigh: (a) four cited statements are pinned to an unnamed 'authors' preprint' or 'author's preprint' of the cited work, not to a published version: Sukhov–Tumanov Section 4.1 (Cauchy estimates), Glöckner Theorem 2.3(ii),(d) (holomorphic implicit function theorem), Wu–Yau Proposition 8(i) and Lemma 6 (cohomological volume strategy), and Namikawa Theorem 6 (Moishezon projectivity with 1-rational singularities). The text does not say which version is meant. (b) The Poletsky–Rosay envelope is applied to ℓ = log|s|²ₖ on the complement of the zero section of the determinant bundle, which is globally unbounded. The text says the envelope theorem applies without boundedness, justified in one sentence by the cited Drinovec Drnovšek–Forstnerič formulation. (c) The area part of the Hessian identity rests on a weak boundary limit along radii chosen by an integrability argument, with an o((1−r)^{1/2}) estimate given in compressed form. The introduction calls boundary behaviour the main analytic difficulty. (d) The convexity claim in the radius-comparison lemma of the smoothing appendix is argued in a few sentences. (e) The introduction says nefness of Kₓ already follows from Ou2025 and Cao–Höring2020 under the absence of rational curves. The manuscript keeps its own disc proof of nefness, and says the further issue for ampleness is positive canonical volume.
